findings: In `extensions/navigate-tree/retrospective-plan.ts`, `readSessionSnapshot` clears `ids` before its second validation loop, then checks label targets and `branch_summary` `fromId` values against `ids`. Consequently, those references are rejected unless already encountered in that second loop, making acceptance dependent on record order.

In `frame.ts`, `sanitizeTerminalText` strips terminal escape sequences and control characters before text is rendered (and searched), preventing those characters from being passed through as ordinary terminal text.
